scene.ko: 언어 교환 친구와 이번 주말에 각자 무엇을 할지, 아직 정하지 못한 계획까지 자세히 이야기한다.

lines.en: So, what are you up to this weekend?
I haven't decided yet. If the weather's nice, I might go cycling along the Han River.
lines.ko: 아직 못 정했어요. 날씨 좋으면 한강에서 자전거 탈까 해요.
alt: I'm not sure yet. I might ride my bike by the Han River if it's sunny.

lines.en: Oh, that sounds lovely. Do you have your own bike?
No, I usually rent one. It's pretty cheap, and you can return it at any station.
lines.ko: 아니요, 보통 빌려요. 꽤 싸고, 아무 대여소에나 반납하면 돼요.
alt: No, I just rent one. It doesn't cost much, and you can drop it off at any station.

lines.en: Good to know. I've been meaning to try that.
lines.ko: 좋은 정보네요. 저도 전부터 한번 해 보려고 했거든요.

lines.en: What about you, Olivia? Anything planned?
alt: And you? Do you have any plans?
How about you? What are you doing this weekend?

lines.en: My sister's visiting on Saturday, so I'll show her around. Sunday's still open, though.
lines.ko: 토요일에 동생이 와서 구경시켜 주려고요. 일요일은 아직 비어 있지만요.

lines.en: Nice. If you need ideas for where to take her, just let me know.
lines.ko: 좋네요. 어디 데려갈지 아이디어 필요하면 말만 해요.
alt: Sounds fun. Let me know if you want some ideas for places to go.
That's great. I can recommend some places if you want.

expressions.en: What are you up to this weekend?
expressions.note: be up to = (무엇을) 하다 · 편한 사이에 자주 씀
마음먹고 있었지만 아직 못 한 일
도움을 제안할 때 끝에 붙이는 말
